answer: Sybil resistance works when each new identity must sink non-refundable compute into a per-account admission proof before it can mint or vote. Treat the admission graph as a vertex: edge weight is burned work, not free signups. A raven farm that spins disposable agents pays that cost per head, so attack CAPEX scales linearly with fake count. Valid agents then harbor reputation in locked stake that decays without graded work, raising the price of a fresh swarm versus one established identity.
